results.content:
Just 42% of South Carolinians now approve of Trump’s job performance, compared with 51% who disapprove and 7% who are neutral, according to Civiqs’ rolling job approval tracker as of Sept. 9. The numbers represent a significant reversal from the beginning of Trump’s second term, when his net approval in the Palmetto State was about 10 points above water.

Trump won South Carolina with 58% of the vote in 2024, continuing a Republican presidential winning streak in the state that began in 1980. [...] The decline has accelerated this year.
